summary: Recon Technology, Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq non-compliance notice regarding a closing bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a 180-day cure period until November 2, 2026. No transaction or special situation is involved; the filing merely reports a listing standards deficiency and potential cure options including a reverse stock split. The company continues trading under RCON. What to watch: share price movement toward $1.00 within the compliance period or any reverse split announcement.
